metas.name: The Adventures of Batman
metas.description: The animated debut of Batman and Robin brings the Dynamic Duo to animated life in Filmation's cult classic take on The Dark Knight and The Boy Wonder, defending Gotham City from The Caped Crusader's Rogues Gallery, one crook at a ...

metas.name: Super Friends
metas.description: The greatest of the DC Comics superheroes work together to uphold the good with the help of some young proteges.

metas.name: The New Adventures of Batman
metas.description: Batman, Robin and Batgirl fight crime in Gotham City with the "help" of Batmite.

metas.name: Batman: The Animated Series
metas.description: Billionaire Bruce Wayne secretly operates as Batman, a vigilante who battles a rouges' gallery of criminals and supervillains in Gotham City with the aid of various sidekicks and allies.

metas.name: Batman: Mask of the Phantasm
metas.description: Batman is wrongly implicated in a series of murders of mob bosses actually committed by a new vigilante assassin.

metas.name: The New Batman Adventures
metas.description: The further and darker adventures of Batman with a new Robin, a closer association with Batgirl and the previous Robin now as Nightwing.

metas.name: The Batman/Superman Movie: World's Finest
metas.description: Joker goes to Metropolis with an offer and plan to kill Superman for Lex Luthor while Batman pursues the clown to Superman's turf.

metas.name: Batman & Mr. Freeze: SubZero
metas.description: When Mr. Freeze, desperate to save his dying wife, kidnaps Barbara Gordon (Batgirl) as an involuntary organ donor, Batman and Robin must find her before the operation can begin.

metas.name: Batman Beyond: The Movie
metas.description: Decades after the retirement of Bruce Wayne as Batman, a boy dons the identity to avenge his own father's murder.

metas.name: Batman Beyond
metas.description: Fuelled by remorse and vengeance, a high schooler named Terry McGinnis revives the role of Batman. Under supervision of an elderly Bruce Wayne, he fights crime in a harsh, futuristic Gotham.

metas.name: Batman Beyond: Return of the Joker
metas.description: The Joker is back with a vengeance, and Gotham's newest Dark Knight needs answers as he stands alone to face Gotham's most infamous Clown Prince of Crime.

metas.name: Justice League
metas.description: Seven of the most formidable heroes form arguably the most powerful team ever.

metas.name: Justice League: Secret Origins
metas.description: When global catastrophe strikes, the World's Greatest Super Heroes answer the call to join Justice League. Justice League works together as a team to overcome a dangerous array of intersteller invaders and world conquering megalomaniacs.

metas.name: Batman: Mystery of the Batwoman
metas.description: The Dark Knight must contend with a mysterious female vigilante who emulates him, but to a more ruthless degree.

metas.name: Chase Me
metas.description: While escaping a dull party, Bruce Wayne finds Catwoman robbing a vault and gives her the chase of her life as Batman.

metas.name: Justice League: Paradise Lost
metas.description: Wonder Woman returns to Paradise Island after her abrupt departure, only to find the Amazons turned to stone. Sorcerer Felix Faust demands three mystical artifacts as the ransom.

metas.name: Justice League Unlimited
metas.description: A continuation of the Justice League animated series finds the original members of the team joined in their battle against crime and evil by dozens of other heroes from the DC comics universe.

metas.name: The Batman
metas.description: Billionaire Bruce Wayne fights crime and evil as the mysterious Batman.

metas.name: Justice League: Starcrossed - The Movie
metas.description: When the Thanagarians visit Earth, Hawkgirl is forced to choose between loyalty to her people and love for her friends on her adopted planet Earth.

metas.name: The Batman vs. Dracula
metas.description: Batman faces off against the original creature of the night, Count Dracula, who has been unintentionally resurrected by the Penguin.

metas.name: Justice League: The New Frontier
metas.description: In the 1950s, a new generation of superheroes must join forces with the community's active veterans and a hostile US government to fight a menace to Earth.

metas.name: Batman: Gotham Knight
metas.description: A collection of key events mark Bruce Wayne's life as he journeys from beginner to Dark Knight.

metas.name: Batman: The Brave and the Bold
metas.description: An updated animated series centering on the Caped Crusader himself as he partners and deals with his fellow superheroes in the DC Comics universe.

metas.name: Batman: Black and White Motion Comics
metas.description: This Black and White TV series features Batman and his adventures in Gotham city.

metas.name: Batman Adventures: Mad Love
metas.description: Harley Quinn is one of the most dangerous criminals in the world. She's also head over heels in love with the Clown Prince of Crime -- the Joker! And to prove her love for her "Puddin," she's going to need to do something awfully special. Something along the lines of... KILLING BATMAN!

metas.name: Superman/Batman: Public Enemies
metas.description: When Lex Luthor gets elected US President, he uses the threat of an oncoming kryptonite meteor striking Earth as a rationale to frame Superman.

metas.name: Justice League: Crisis on Two Earths
metas.description: A good version of Lex Luthor from a parallel Earth comes to the Justice League's dimension for help to fight their evil counterparts.

metas.name: Batman: Under the Red Hood
metas.description: There's a mystery afoot in Gotham City, and Batman must go toe-to-toe with a mysterious vigilante, who goes by the name of Red Hood. Subsequently, old wounds reopen and old, once buried memories come into the light.

metas.name: Superman/Batman: Apocalypse
metas.description: Batman discovers a mysterious teen-aged girl with super-human powers and a connection to Superman. When the girl comes to the attention of Darkseid, the evil overlord of Apokolips, events take a decidedly dangerous turn.

metas.name: DC Super Friends: The Joker's Playhouse
metas.description: The Joker kidnaps Batman, Superman and the rest of the DC Super Friends and puts them against their worst enemies in their own secret base, the Hall of Justice.

metas.name: Batman: Year One
metas.description: A wealthy playboy and a Chicago cop both return to Gotham City where their lives will intersect in unexpected ways.

metas.name: Justice League: Doom
metas.description: Vandal Savage steals confidential files Batman has compiled on the members of the Justice League, and learns all their weaknesses.

metas.name: The Bat Man of Shanghai
metas.description: A re-imagining of the DC Comics character, as he fights crime in 1930 Shanghai.

metas.name: Robot Chicken: DC Comics Special
metas.description: The Robot Chicken DC Comics Special brings you the awesomeness of the DC Comics universe of characters as only Robot Chicken can, with amazing guest stars and the stop-motion sketch comedy you've come to love.

metas.name: Batman: The Dark Knight Returns, Part 1
metas.description: Batman has not been seen for ten years. A new breed of criminal ravages Gotham City, forcing 55-year-old Bruce Wayne back into the cape and cowl. But, does he still have what it takes to fight crime in a new era?

metas.name: Batman: The Dark Knight Returns, Part 2
metas.description: The Batman has returned after a 10-year absence. The Gotham authorities want to arrest him. An old foe wants a reunion. The Feds want the Man of Tomorrow to put a stop to him.

metas.name: LEGO Batman: The Movie - DC Super Heroes Unite
metas.description: When the Joker and Lex Luthor form an alliance, Batman must team up with the Justice League in order to stop them.

metas.name: Beware the Batman
metas.description: Batman, a crime-fighting vigilante of Gotham City, goes up against the underworld.

metas.name: Justice League: The Flashpoint Paradox
metas.description: The Flash finds himself in a war torn alternate timeline and teams up with alternate versions of his fellow heroes to return home and restore the timeline.

metas.name: The Riddler: Riddle Me This
metas.description: The Riddler matches wits with Batman, but the encounters never go well.

metas.name: JLA Adventures: Trapped in Time
metas.description: Lex Luthor is frozen during a battle with the Justice League. He thaws out in the 31st century, discovers Time Trapper and prevents Superman's arrival to Earth as a baby. Future teen heroes Karate Kid and Dawnstar must stop him.

metas.name: Justice League: War
metas.description: The world's finest heroes found the Justice League in order to stop an alien invasion of Earth.

metas.name: Robot Chicken DC Comics Special II: Villains in Paradise
metas.description: When Lex Luthor's daughter runs away with her boyfriend Superboy and the Justice League, the Legion of Doom take a trip to the beach to find the missing teen.

metas.name: Son of Batman
metas.description: Batman learns he has a violent, unruly pre-teen son, secretly raised by the terrorist group the League of Assassins.

metas.name: Batman: Assault on Arkham
metas.description: Batman works desperately to find a bomb planted by the Joker while Amanda Waller hires her newly formed Suicide Squad to break into Arkham Asylum to recover vital information stolen by the Riddler.

metas.name: LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: Batman Be-Leaguered
metas.description: Superman wants Batman to join his new superhero team, but Batman prides himself on being a self-sufficient loner.

metas.name: Batman: Strange Days
metas.description: A lost tale from Batman's past, the Dark Knight tracks a strange giant to the mysterious lair of Hugo Strange.

metas.name: Batman Beyond
metas.description: This short celebrating 75 years of Batman from artist Darwyn Cooke returns fans to the world of Batman Beyond as Terry McGinnis' futuristic Dark Knight faces his most formidable foe of all - himself.

metas.name: Justice League: Throne of Atlantis
metas.description: When Atlantian troops assault Metropolis as revenge for the death of their king, the Queen seeks help from the Justice League to find her son who has gone missing during the madness.

metas.name: LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League vs. Bizarro League
metas.description: It's up to the Justice League to team up with their bizarre counterparts to stop Darkseid and save the galaxy!

metas.name: Batman vs. Robin
metas.description: While Damian Wayne struggles to cope with Batman's no-killing rule, he soon starts to believe that his destiny lies within a secret society known as, The Court of Owls.

metas.name: Batman Unlimited
metas.description: This merchandise show displays short episodic battles, and other encounters, around Batman and his Batfamily like Nightwing, Red Robin and Robin. The episodes manage without dialogues.

metas.name: Batman Unlimited: Animal Instincts
metas.description: Batman, with the help of the Flash, Green Arrow, Nightwing, and Red Robin, has to try and get to the bottom of the mysterious robotic animals attacking Gotham.

metas.name: Justice League: Gods and Monsters Chronicles
metas.description: Taking place in an alternate reality featuring their versions of Superman, Wonder Woman, and Batman.

metas.name: Justice League: Gods and Monsters
metas.description: In an alternate universe, very different versions of DC's Trinity (Superman, Batman and Wonder Woman), who operate outside of the law, are framed for murders of prominent scientist and the government decides to take them out.

metas.name: Batman Unlimited: Monster Mayhem
metas.description: The Joker is aided in his Halloween quest to render modern technology useless and take over Gotham City by Solomon Grundy, Silver Banshee, Clayface and Scarecrow.

metas.name: LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League - Attack of the Legion of Doom!
metas.description: Get ready for the bricks to fly when Superman, Batman, Wonder Woman and the rest of the Justice League face off against the world's greatest super villains!

metas.name: Robot Chicken DC Comics Special III: Magical Friendship
metas.description: Batman and Superman's bromance turns competitive and the fate of the universe hangs in the balance.

metas.name: Nightwing and Robin
metas.description: A 45 second short film set during the events of Justice League: Throne of Atlantis. The two main characters are called upon by Batman to find and capture the Scarecrow.

metas.name: Batman: Bad Blood
metas.description: Bruce Wayne is missing. Alfred covers for him while Nightwing and Robin patrol Gotham City in his stead. And a new player, Batwoman, investigates Batman's disappearance.

metas.name: LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League - Cosmic Clash
metas.description: When Brainiac zaps Superman, Wonder Woman, and Green Lantern, Batman and Flash have to go back in time to save them.

metas.name: Justice League vs. Teen Titans
metas.description: Robin is sent to work with the Teen Titans after his volatile behavior botches a Justice League mission. The Titans must then face Trigon after he possesses the League and threatens to conquer the world.

metas.name: LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League - Gotham City Breakout
metas.description: Batman goes on vacation and chaos erupts in Gotham.

metas.name: Batman: The Killing Joke
metas.description: As Batman hunts for the escaped Joker, the Clown Prince of Crime attacks the Gordon family to prove a diabolical point mirroring his own fall into madness.

metas.name: Batman Unlimited: Mechs vs. Mutants
metas.description: After freeing helpers in Arkham, Freeze and Penguin freeze down Gotham City and attack with huge monsters. Batman responds, helped by other heroes.

metas.name: Batman: Return of the Caped Crusaders
metas.description: Batman and Robin of the 1960s live action series are back in action to take down their fiendish foes united once more against them.

metas.name: Justice League Action
metas.description: Batman, Superman and Wonder Woman will lead the DC Super Heroes against their most infamous foes.

metas.name: Justice League Dark
metas.description: Beings with supernatural powers join together to fight against supernatural villains. This team of supernatural beings include John Constantine, Zatanna and Jason Blood also known as the demon Etrigan.

metas.name: The Lego Batman Movie
metas.description: A cooler-than-ever Bruce Wayne must deal with the usual suspects as they plan to rule Gotham City, while discovering that he has accidentally adopted a teenage orphan who wishes to become his sidekick.

metas.name: Batman and Harley Quinn
metas.description: Batman and Nightwing are forced to team with the Joker's sometimes-girlfriend Harley Quinn to stop a global threat brought about by Poison Ivy and Jason Woodrue, the Floronic Man.

metas.name: Batman vs. Two-Face
metas.description: Gotham City District Attorney Harvey Dent is mutilated in a laboratory accident. When the duplicitous Two-Face embarks on a crime spree, Batman and Robin must solve the mystery of his identity while facing off against several other foes.

metas.name: DC Super Heroes vs. Eagle Talon
metas.description: Joker has come to Japan to steal the Eagle Talon Society's secret weapons in his continued scheme for pure chaos. However, the Justice League is on his trail, but there's something off with Batman. Now, it's up to Eagle Talon to g...

metas.name: Scooby-Doo! & Batman: The Brave and the Bold
metas.description: Batman teams up with the Scooby Doo gang when villains from both of their worlds unite to wreak havoc on the city.

metas.name: Batman: Gotham by Gaslight
metas.description: In an alternative Victorian Age Gotham City, Batman begins his war on crime while he investigates a new series of murders by Jack the Ripper.

metas.name: LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: The Flash
metas.description: Reverse-Flash manipulates the Speed Force to put The Flash into a time loop, which forces him to re-live the same day over and over again. The Flash must find a way to restore time and finally apprehend his worst enemy before all is lost.

metas.name: Batman Ninja
metas.description: Batman, along with a number of his allies and adversaries, finds himself transplanted from modern Gotham City to feudal Japan.

metas.name: The Death of Superman
metas.description: Superman battles against an insurmountable foe named Doomsday.

metas.name: Teen Titans Go! To the Movies
metas.description: A villain's maniacal plan for world domination gets in the way of the Teen Titans' dream of superhero stardom in Hollywood.

metas.name: LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: Aquaman - Rage of Atlantis
metas.description: Aquaman must battle foes in the air, on land and in the depths of the Seven Seas, along with some help from The Justice League, to save the day .

metas.name: Reign of the Supermen
metas.description: After the death of Superman, several new people present themselves as possible successors.

metas.name: Justice League vs. the Fatal Five
metas.description: The Justice League battles the Fatal Five, (Tharok, Emerald Empress, Validus, Mano and the Persuader). Based on the characters created by Jim Shooter.

metas.name: Batman vs Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
metas.description: Batman, Batgirl and Robin forge an alliance with The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles to fight against the Turtles' sworn enemy, The Shredder, who has teamed up with Ra's Al Ghul and The League Of Assassins.

metas.name: Batman: Hush
metas.description: When threads from Batman's past begin to unravel, the race is on for him to crack Hush's deadly game. Strange alliances will form and shattering secrets will be revealed when Hush's silence is finally broken.

metas.name: LEGO DC Batman: Family Matters
metas.description: In LEGO DC: Batman - Family Matters, suspicion is on high after Batman, Batgirl, Robin and other DC superheroes receive mysterious invitations. However, family values must remain strong when Batman and his team encounter the villa...

metas.name: Superman: Red Son
metas.description: What if baby Kal-El's rocket landed, not in Kansas, but in the Soviet Union? That is the premise of this Elseworld's tale from DC Comics.

metas.name: LEGO DC: Shazam! Magic and Monsters
metas.description: When the boy hero Shazam is offered to join the Justice League he is reluctant about it, but when his rivals the Monster Society put the League in peril he's the only one who can save them.

metas.name: Justice League Dark: Apokolips War
metas.description: A Sequel to Justice League Dark (2017) involving Jack Kirby's New Gods.

metas.name: Batman: Death in the Family
metas.description: An anthology series of 5 DC showcase: Death in the Family, Sgt. Rock, Adam Strange, The Phantom Stranger and Death.

metas.name: Batman: Soul of the Dragon
metas.description: In the 1970s, a missing teacher of martial arts is the subject of a quest by his devoted and brilliant but distant students, who include Batman.

metas.name: Batman: The Long Halloween, Part One
metas.description: Held hostage by the powerful Falcone crime family, Gotham City is rife with crime and corruption. Adding to the chaos is the mysterious Holiday killer, who has been targeting the underworld and leaving a trail of terror - and body...

metas.name: Batman: The Long Halloween, Part Two
metas.description: The killer known as Holiday continues to stalk the Falcone crime family while a new class of costumed criminal rises in Gotham City. Batman suspects that a former ally might be the serial killer.

metas.name: Injustice
metas.description: On an alternate Earth, the Joker tricks Superman into killing Lois Lane, which causes a rampage in the hero. Superman decides to take control of Earth; Batman and his allies will have to attempt to stop him.

metas.name: Batman: The Long Halloween Deluxe Edition
metas.description: Atrocious serial killings on holidays in Gotham City send The World's Greatest Detective into action - confronting both organized crime and a unified front of classic DC Super-Villains - while attempting to stop the mysterious mur...

metas.name: Teen Titans Go! & DC Super Hero Girls: Mayhem in the Multiverse
metas.description: Teen Titans and DC Super Hero Girls will reunite to combat Lex Luthor and his unified gang of DC Super-Villains.

metas.name: DC League of Super-Pets
metas.description: Krypto the Super-Dog and Superman are inseparable best friends, sharing the same superpowers and fighting crime side by side in Metropolis. However, Krypto must master his own powers for a rescue mission when Superman is kidnapped.

metas.name: Batman and Superman: Battle of the Super Sons
metas.description: Jonathan Kent and reluctant young sidekick Damian Wayne are burdened with saving the world from impending doom. The two must join forces to rescue their fathers and save the planet by becoming the super heroes they were intended t...

metas.name: Batwheels
metas.description: The Batwheels are a team of sentient super-powered crimefighting vehicles that help Batman, Robin and Batgirl—as well as a host of additional DC Super Heroes—keep Gotham City safe. Created only recently by the Batcomputer, our mechanized heroes must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super-team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

metas.name: Legion of Super-Heroes
metas.description: Kara, devastated by the loss of Krypton, struggles to adjust to her new life on Earth. Superman mentors her. Meanwhile, she must contend with a mysterious group called the Dark Circle who searches for a powerful weapon held in the...

metas.name: Batman: The Doom That Came to Gotham
metas.description: An ancient evil awakens and only Bruce Wayne can save 1920s Gotham City.

metas.name: Justice League x RWBY: Super Heroes & Huntsmen, Part One
metas.description: The DC universe's premier superhero team are transported to the world of Remnant where they are transformed into teenagers and must join forces with Team RWBY to fight against superpowered Grimm.

metas.name: Justice League: Warworld
metas.description: Warworld, a place of unending brutal gladiatorial combat, Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman and others must unite to form an unbeatable resistance to lead the entire planet to freedom.

metas.name: Merry Little Batman
metas.description: Damian Wayne is left alone at home while his father, Batman, goes out to help the Justice League on Christmas Eve, but ends up discovering a plot in Gotham to steal Christmas and take the chance to be a superhero like Batman.

metas.name: Justice League x RWBY: Super Heroes & Huntsmen, Part Two
metas.description: After their adventure in Remnant cyberspace, courtesy of Kilg%re, the Justice League returns to Earth. However, they find the Grimm have followed them and are somehow duplicating their powers. Bringing Black Canary up to speed, th...

metas.name: Justice League: Crisis on Infinite Earths Part One
metas.description: The Anti-Monitor, the Monitor's evil counterpart, is released into the DC Multiverse and begins to destroy the different Earths that compose it. The Monitor attempts to recruit heroes from across the Multiverse to fight back.

metas.name: Justice League: Crisis on Infinite Earths Part Two
metas.description: The Anti-Monitor (the Monitor's evil counterpart) is released into the DC Multiverse and begins to destroy the different Earths that compose it. The Monitor attempts to recruit heroes from across the Multiverse to fight back.

metas.name: Justice League: Crisis on Infinite Earths Part Three
metas.description: Trapped in a pocket universe, surviving Earths face annihilation by the Anti-Monitor. Time shatters, bringing past heroes to aid Justice League against the epitome of evil. Their sacrifice may lead to victory.

metas.name: Batman: Caped Crusader
metas.description: After a family tragedy, affluent philanthropist Bruce Wayne transforms into The Batman, where his crusade for justice spawns unforeseen ramifications.

metas.name: DC Heroes United
metas.description: When the story of Earth-212 begin,s our favorite Super Heroes and Super-Villains remain in the shadows, largely unknown to one another and mostly serving as legend and rumor to civilians. The appearance of the magical Tower of Fate in Gotham City thrusts these fledgling heroes into the spotlight – together and in opposition.

metas.name: Batman Ninja vs. Yakuza League
metas.description: Batman is confronted by an invasion from an alternate world of Japan, that has its own version of the Justice League.

metas.name: Aztec Batman: Clash of Empires
metas.description: A young Aztec boy experiences tragedy when his father is murdered by Spanish Conquistadors. Yohualli escapes to Tenochtitlan to warn King Moctezuma and his high priest, Yoka, of imminent danger.

metas.name: Bat-Fam
metas.description: Follow Batman, Alfred, and young Damian Wayne—who has taken on the mantle of Little Batman—alongside a few newcomers to Wayne Manor, as they navigate the fun and frustrations of life as a super family

metas.name: Batman: Knightfall - Part 1: Knightfall
metas.description: When the mysterious behemoth known only as Bane frees Batman's entire rogue's gallery from Arkham Asylum, the Caped Crusader is pushed to his mental and physical breaking point.

metas.name: Batman: Knightfall Part 2: Knightquest
metas.description: Batman lies broken at the hands of the villainous mastermind Bane. With Bruce Wayne paralyzed from the waist down and unable to continue as Batman, a new successor must be chosen to defend Gotham City. Jean-Paul Valley, the man also known as Azrael, must take up the mantle of the Batman. But will his more violent methods be enough to stop Bane?
